name: sapientpriors-site
//type: All three api/ functions are ESM (export default handler). apply.js and contact.js predate this package.json and worked because Node falls back to ESM detection when no type is declared - a fallback that warns on every cold start and is not something two live form endpoints should depend on. Declared explicitly so the runtime is told rather than left to guess.
description: Static marketing site plus the Vercel functions beside it. The site itself has no build step; these dependencies exist only for /api/try, which is the one endpoint that talks to something other than a form provider.
